name: Open-Ear Hook Earbuds — LED Display Case
description: Open-ear wireless earbuds with a glossy metallic-trim finish, in an oval charging case with an LED display. The buds sit outside the ear canal. Comes in white, black and cream.

source.notes: Style "X96", ¥13.00. Rate 223.9 ₦/¥ (listing header). Shop confirmed as Huixun by the style picker. Owner set the price (₦7000). Photos 1179 px square, clean on white, padded to 4:5. Cream/gold display reads 99% (photo only). Store has clip-on-earbuds-led/dome/pebble (clip-on Q71 style, ₦10,000, ¥15.9) and in-ear-earbuds-display: this is a different shape (oval case, hook/open-ear buds), not a duplicate. Lithium battery: sea freight only. Owner sent photos with no message; shop, listing, style name and ¥ price unknown. Likely the Shenzhen Huixun listing (offerId 1025659251706, 58.6% return rate) but unconfirmed: if so, samples first and stay unpublished. No Bluetooth version, battery, playtime or waterproofing claimed.
